profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer II @ State Farm | Microsoft Power Platform
profile.summary:
As Lead Software Engineer II at State Farm, I lead the Low Code team to support the Microsoft Power Platform across the enterprise. My focus includes leveraging Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, and Copilot Studio to develop full-stack applications that enhance operational efficiency and user experience.  

With a Master’s degree in App and Web Services Development and a Bachelor's in Computer Science, I bring a strong technical foundation to my work. I am currently advancing my expertise AI-assisted development applied to Power Playform. My commitment lies in creating innovative, technology-driven solutions that address business challenges and improve processes.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer II
positions.description: Leading State Farm’s Low Code team to support Microsoft Power Platform for the entire enterprise.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
In my current role, I specialize in the development of full-stack applications using Microsoft Power Platform and the management of Robotic Process Automation (RPA) bots utilizing Pegasystems software, which operate seamlessly on virtual machines. Some of my responsibilities encompass:

   • RPA Development: Designing, implementing, and overseeing RPA bots to enhance operational efficiency and streamline business processes.

   • Full-Stack Application Development: Leveraging Microsoft's Power Platform tools to create robust applications. I utilize:
      • Dataverse: To store and manage relational data efficiently.
      • Power Apps: For crafting modern user interfaces that connect to databases and various services.
      • Power Automate: To execute data management operations and automate workflows.

   • API Management: Managing multiple REST API calls for application integration, utilizing Postman for testing and validation prior to implementation.

   • Team Leadership: Leading a talented team of engineers, assigning tasks, providing mentorship, and fostering an innovative mindset to drive projects to successful completion.


My focus is on delivering high-quality solutions that not only meet business needs but also enhance user experience through technology.
